description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of the number of conversations across four categories—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—based on the perception of being deceived. The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Conversations," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, marked at intervals of 10. The vertical axis lists the four categories. Each category contains three stacked bars representing the levels of deception: "Yes" (red), "Partially" (yellow), and "No" (green). In Academic Collaboration, the "Yes" bar extends to approximately 35, while the "Partially" and "No" bars are both under 10. In Recruitment, the "Yes" bar reaches about 38, slightly shorter than the "Partially" bar, which extends to approximately 40, with the "No" bar under 10. For Academic Funding, the "Yes" bar is the longest, extending beyond 60, while the "Partially" and "No" bars are both under 10. In Journalism, the "Partially" bar is the longest, reaching approximately 50, with the "Yes" and "No" bars each around 15. The bars are grouped by category, with no additional visual emphasis or annotations.
